nom: Exuviance AGE REVERSE+ Total 360 Eye Contour

segments.dry: A reviewer with dry skin says she typically needs a more hydrating eye moisturizer than this one, while another attributes years of stinging under concealer to dry skin and calls this cream a game changer.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin or sensitive eyes mostly report no irritation, stinging, or redness even with potent anti-aging ingredients, though one with sensitive eyes noted a little irritation.
segments.mature: A couple of reviewers approaching or in their late 30s and 40s report the cream smoothing crow's feet and firming sagging skin around the eyes.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visibly softer fine lines, tighter crow's feet, or firmer-looking skin after two to several weeks of consistent use, though several say they saw no noticeable difference even after a month or more.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the cream as hydrating and plumping without feeling heavy, though a few report it dried their skin out, left it feeling tight, or felt less moisturizing after a recent formula change to a gel texture.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive skin or sensitive eyes, report no irritation, stinging, or redness, though one reviewer with sensitive eyes noted a little irritation.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report a visible reduction in dark circles and brighter under-eyes within a few weeks, though a few say they saw no meaningful change even after a month or more of use.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers specifically note the cream did not cause breakouts or milia, including one who was concerned about milia from thick eye creams.

aspects.libelle: Lightweight texture absorbs quickly without residue
Pump dispenses precisely, a little goes a long way
Expensive for the small bottle size
Pump can malfunction or need priming
Layers well under makeup without pilling

extraits.texte: Total waste of money, especially for an expensive product. No change in my eye issues. I did better with a Target brand!!!

extraits.titre: My fav eye cream until the formula was changed
extraits.texte: Absolutely loved this eye cream. It hydrated, reduced lines, plumped, and made me look refreshed. I hated the price tag but would get it any time it as on sale or using points. The formula was more of a cream and was super moisturizing but it recently changed to a gel texture. I feel like its not as moisturizing and feels like it just sits on the skin. I'm sad. I don't know if I would buy again.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I Was not a fan of this. It did nothing for me and dried my skin out. I tried it for a few months and had to stop using it. Definitely not for me.. wont use again

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This eye cream is very light weight. It absorbs quickly. Doesn't feel greasy or sticky at all. I don't notice any immediate improvements. However, that may be seen with time and consistent use. May be best suited for oily skin or skin that doesn't lack much hydration. I have dry skin and I typically need a more hydrating eye moisturizer.

Before I started using this eye cream my undereyes would sting/burn when I applied concealer. After researching I realized this was due to dry skin. After trying several other eye creams, I found this one. It was a game changer! Goes on smooth and only takes a pea sized amount. I have also noticed a big difference in my under eye appearance and feel. Definitely recommend!

extraits.titre: Absolute Game Changer For Tired Eyes!
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm absolutely blown away by the Exuviance Age+ Total 360 Eye Contour. As someone struggling with fine lines and dark circles finding a product that actually delivers what its promises is rare.👀 Texture is super lightweight, non-greasy and absorbs instantly. It brights the eye area skin almost instantly and if you wake up with puffy eyes this product is for you. Trust me, in just a few minutes you'll see the difference. The addition of MicroDiPeptide and Caffeine really wakes up my entire eye area making me look well-rested. 💧 What impress me the most about how gentle this formula is how gentle it is. I was a bit nervous when I first tried it due to its such powerful anti-aging ingredients, but it didn't irritate my skin or leave me with any redness at all even though I have sensitive skin. 🌟 It is on the pricey side, but a little goes a long way thanks to the airless pump design. If you are looking for a serious, medical-grade anti-aging eye cream that targets sagging, wrinkles and dark circles all at once, this is worth every penny!

extraits.titre: Hydrating eye treatment that smooth, tight, and wears beauti
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the Exuviance total 360 eye contour for a few weeks and overall I'm really impressed. The packaging feels sleek and high-end, and a little product goes a long way. I noticed my under eye area looked smoother and more refreshed, especially in the mornings. It gave a nice feeling of tightness without making my skin feel dry or uncomfortable. I was worried about sensitivity since the skin around my eyes can react easily, but I didn't experience irritation or redness. The scent is light and clean, which I appreciated because overly fragranced eye products usually bother me. I also didn't have issues with piling under makeup or concealer, which is a huge plus for daytime wear. The texture is creamy, but lightweight, absorbs quickly, and layers nicely with the rest of my skin care routine. Overall, this made my under eye area, feel hydrated, smoother, and more awake.
